name: DNS

evidence.rationale: Use standard hardening templates for DNS servers to implement zone transfer policies that permit zone transfers only to validated servers to help prevent adversaries from gathering DNS information.

This relationship applies when penetration testing identifies the described software configuration weakness and remediation of the finding changes the DNS zone transfers to explicitly authorized servers and correct other DNS service settings that expose internal naming information.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
